title: Cryptochrome spin-state history and neural responses: computational source companion
description:
Computational source companion to the manuscript Conditions for transmitting cryptochrome spin-state history to neural responses (Physical Biology submission draft). Contains the compiled manuscript and supplement PDFs, the calculation modules, simulation/analysis drivers and data-free numerical tests.

The five modules (spin history and population storage, chemical product routing, three-state Hk storage, conditional synaptic circuit, published current-data reanalysis) are separate conditional tests, not successive stages of a calibrated biological pathway. Precomputed results and third-party source data are not included; see README for the inputs required to reproduce each calculation.
notes: Source code is released under the MIT License. The manuscript and supplement PDFs (paper/manuscript.pdf, paper/supplement.pdf) are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Third-party source data are not redistributed.
